annotations.title: Check a tool before installing it

description: Evidence summary for an MCP server before you install or connect it: publisher identity level, provenance, known vulnerabilities, install scripts, maintenance, open warnings, checks that could not run, and recent changes. Pass installed (the servers already in use) to also get tool names this server shares with them, which an AI could call by mistake. No warnings is NOT a safety guarantee.

identifier.description: MCP server name (e.g. io.github.github/github-mcp-server), catalog id, or GitHub repository URL

installed.description: Optional: names of MCP servers already installed, to check for tool-name clashes (first 20 used)

name: check_before_install
title: Check a tool before installing it
